$comment: Golden base: the pinned system and modules a rebuilt Foundry install needs.
Nothing here floats. 'Always latest' is the documented hazard, not the goal
(see docs/PROJECT.md on foundry-mcp module/server drift). Move a pin with
`node scripts/content/foundry-base.mjs update`, review the diff, commit it.
Versions and manifest URLs are marked TODO where they must come from a real
install rather than a guess: a wrong module id fails at rebuild time, which
is the worst time. Fill them with:
and promote what belongs into 'core' below.

deliberatelyExcluded.fa-battlemaps: Large art asset pack; would bloat every snapshot. Install on demand.
deliberatelyExcluded.multi-token-edit: Bulk placeable editor. Its main use is fixing up hand-built scenes; this pipeline generates walls, lights and notes from the map spec instead. Its presets are world-scoped and would not survive a rebuild anyway.
deliberatelyExcluded.scene-packer: Packages scenes with their dependencies — overlaps what the compendium pipeline already does.
